response.overview: To explore the theme of tolerance, the director chose, as an example, the conflict between Jews and Arabs in Israel and relate his own experience with Inuits in Northern lands. " I have always had a fascination for Israel (...) I could not move on from the idea that the situation between Jews and Palestinians related to us. We are a conquered people but compared to the natives, we are a people of conquerors". (Bernard Émond)
response.title: La terre des autres
